name: securin-platform
description: Securin Platform skills for exposure triage, CVE enrichment, threat correlation, and remediation guidance. Connects to the Securin MCP server with per user OAuth single sign on. A Securin account is required.

interface.shortDescription: Triage exposures and enrich CVEs from your Securin account
interface.longDescription: Six Securin skills guide exposure triage, CVE enrichment, threat correlation, and remediation guidance. The remote MCP server is https://mcp.securin.io/mcp. Each person signs in with Securin OAuth. The plugin reads the accounts and workspaces that the signed in user can already open. It does not grant a shared service account.
defaultPrompt: Break down assets by criticality and workspace.

positive.expected_behavior: Return severity, exploitation context, and Risk Index fields for that CVE from Securin, with a platform link when the tool provides one.
Return exposures visible to the signed in account, or ask which account to use when several accounts are available.

positive.prompt: Break down assets by criticality and workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return counts for the signed in account. Do not invent assets.

positive.description: Correlate one CVE to the environment
positive.expected_behavior: Compare that CVE with exposures in the signed in account and state whether matching exposures were found.

positive.description: Draft a fix without creating a ticket
positive.expected_behavior: Return remediation text from the platform record and a draft the user can copy. Do not create a ticket.

negative.prompt: Delete all exposures in the account.

negative.description: Do not create a ticket without confirmation
negative.prompt: Create a Jira ticket for every critical exposure right now.
Show exposures from an account this user cannot open.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial package. Six skills and the remote Securin MCP server, with per user OAuth.
